Kimberly / Ben — reviewed the draft and the current MSA template. High level summary and recommended redlines below. 

1) Publicity clause (recommended language to add to Order Form or a short addendum):
"Customer may publicly announce the engagement and reference Redwood Inference's name and trademarks solely as set forth in an approved form provided to Redwood in writing. Prior to publication, Customer must submit the final press release text and any proposed use of Redwood's marks to Redwood for written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Redwood will provide approval or comments within three (3) business days of receipt."

2) Confidentiality carve-out: do NOT permit disclosure of Confidential Information (as defined in the MSA). The PR may reference the nature of the work in high-level terms but must not include any confidential pricing, non-public performance metrics, or customer data. If the draft includes examples that look like internal metrics, we need those removed.

3) Quotes: we prefer Redwood to approve any quote attributed to our company. If ClientCo wants Redwood to provide an official quote, please send a proposed sentence. Legal will push to limit quote to a single short sentence and require prior approval.

4) Logos / brand assets: require use to follow Redwood brand guidelines; we will supply an approved logo file and a usage spec. Any modifications to the logo (colors, proportions) are not permitted.

5) Embargos & timing: if there's an embargo, please state the embargo datetime in the submission. We can typically meet embargo timing provided the submission is complete and in final form 72 hours prior. For shorter timelines we'll need Sales to escalate and we may only approve text (no case study) until a follow-up review.

6) Suggested evidence & next steps (please provide):
- Final PR text (track-changes off)
- Exact quote requested from Redwood (1–2 short sentences)
- Logo usage mock (PNG/JPEG) and placement mock in the release
- HubSpot/Order Form link for our records

I've attached a one-page PDF with redline suggestions for the Order Form (MSA_OrderForm_Redlines.pdf). If Kimberly/Ben want to allow a limited pre-approved template quote for marketing purposes, we can consider adding one in the Order Form as an exception.

Marissa Cole
